bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_CHECKOUT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_CHECKOUT_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
printf 'BOT_RUNNING=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"
printf 'BOT_IMAGE=%s\n' "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-25 || true)"
printf 'BOT_DM_POLL_READY_LOG=%s\n' "$(docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || true)"
printf 'BOT_GATE_CONNECTED_LOG=%s\n' "$(docker logs --tail 120 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -c '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || true)"
printf 'SOURCE_FIX_PRESENT=%s\n' "$(grep -c 'there is no text in the message to edit' src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs || true)"
